title.zh: 大多伦多地区
title.en: GTA

title.zh: 多伦多市长竞选最后一场辩论：周一投票前住房与水务交锋
title.en: Chow and Bradford clash in final mayoral debate before Monday's vote

summary.zh: 周四晚，周凯怡与布拉德福德在CP24主办的最后一场市长辩论中，围绕住房、税收和多伦多水务交锋。布拉德福德称周凯怡的住房目标落后，周凯怡则说他把水务变成公用事业的方案等于私有化。选举日为10月26日，调查显示仍有13%选民可能改变主意。
summary.en: Olivia Chow and Brad Bradford met for the last time on Thursday night in a debate hosted by CP24, sparring over housing, taxes and Toronto Water. Bradford said Chow is falling short on her housing goal, while she called his water plan a route to privatization. Election day is Oct. 26, and Nanos found 13 per cent of voters open to switching.

title.zh: Crime Stoppers数据泄露：近17.7万条多伦多线报受影响
title.en: Crime Stoppers breach: 176,859 Toronto tips hit, police suspend use

summary.zh: 多伦多Crime Stoppers主席说，第三方软件供应商被黑，影响了176,859条多伦多线报。该组织已暂停网站、电话和手机应用收线报；多伦多警方和哈尔顿警方也暂停使用。市民可通过警方现有渠道举报，但这些渠道不是匿名的。
summary.en: Toronto Crime Stoppers says 176,859 of its tips were affected by a breach at its software provider, and it has stopped taking tips by web, phone and app. Toronto and Halton police have suspended use of the platform too. Police say people can still report through regular channels, though those are not anonymous. Call 911 in an emergency.

title.zh: 大多伦多地区新公寓9月销量创同月历史新低
title.en: GTA new condo sales hit a record low for September

summary.zh: 开发商协会BILD和Altus的数据显示，9月大多伦多地区只卖出129套新公寓，同比下降约40%，是有记录以来9月最低。新房总销量为949套，同比增长约64%，其中独立屋等低层住宅有820套。BILD称消费税减免对低层住宅帮助更大，公寓项目较难符合条件。
summary.en: Only 129 new condo units sold in the GTA in September, down about 40 per cent from a year earlier and the weakest September on record, BILD and Altus Group report. Total new-home sales were 949, up about 64 per cent, led by 820 low-rise homes. BILD says the HST rebate helps low-rise buyers more because condo projects struggle to qualify.

title.zh: CBC调查：安大略网络赌场开放后，问题赌博与自杀人数大增
title.en: CBC: problem gambling and suicides jump in Ontario since online casinos opened

summary.zh: CBC调查报道，阿尔伯塔赌博研究所估计安大略约有13万人出现问题赌博迹象，2018年约为4.3万。验尸数据显示，与赌博相关的自杀人数从每年约5人升至约三倍。联邦议员正推动限制体育博彩广告，但安大略和阿尔伯塔代表反对。
summary.en: A CBC investigation reports that nearly 130,000 Ontarians now show signs of problem gambling, up from about 43,000 in 2018, according to Alberta Gambling Research Institute estimates. Coroner data show gambling-related suicides tripled from about five a year since the province opened online casinos in 2022. Federal MPs are pushing to curb betting ads, but Ontario and Alberta oppose it.

title.zh: 四人闯入多伦多市中心大楼上屋顶拍照被控
title.en: Four charged after break-in at Toronto building to take rooftop photos

summary.zh: 多伦多警方说，四名嫌疑人10月18日强行进入市中心一栋大楼的受限区域，爬上屋顶拍摄照片发到社交媒体。警方称，四人逃离时袭击了一名保安和一名大楼经理，已被控入室盗窃和袭击等罪名，其中一人还被控违反缓刑条件。警方强调，这类行为违法，也很危险。
summary.en: Toronto police have charged four people after they allegedly forced their way into a restricted area of a downtown building on Oct. 18 and climbed to the roof to take photos for social media. Police say two security staff were assaulted during the escape, and the four face break-and-enter and assault charges, with one also charged with breaching probation. Police say stunts like this are both illegal and dangerous.

title.zh: 沃恩肇事逃逸致死案：41岁男子被控，嫌疑车辆仍未找到
title.en: Vaughan fatal hit-and-run: man, 41, charged; suspect vehicle still missing

summary.zh: 约克区警方10月19日指控一名41岁男子，涉及10月4日晚在沃恩Pine Valley Drive撞死一名60岁女子的肇事逃逸案。警方此前公布监控影像，称嫌疑车辆可能是白色2020至2022年款奔驰Sprinter厢式货车。这辆车至今没有找到。
summary.en: York police on Oct. 19 charged a 41-year-old man in the Oct. 4 hit-and-run that killed a 60-year-old woman on Pine Valley Drive in Vaughan. Security video earlier pointed to a white 2020-2022 Mercedes-Benz Sprinter van. The suspect vehicle has still not been found, and police continue to appeal for information.

title.zh: 警员涉Project South案获缓刑一年
title.en: Toronto officer gets one year of probation in Project South case

summary.zh: 多伦多警员穆瓦德因非法使用警方电脑系统，被法官判处一年缓刑和100小时社区服务，并禁止与两名共同被告接触。法庭称，他曾违规为朋友查询车牌，但这属于严重的判断失误，而非一贯行为。检方原本要求四个月刑期。
summary.en: Toronto police constable Elias Mouawad was sentenced to one year of probation and 100 hours of community service for unauthorized use of a computer in the Project South probe. He used police systems to look up a licence plate for a friend. The judge called it a serious lapse of judgment, not entrenched behaviour. The Crown had sought four months.

title.zh: 拆除自行车道抗议持续：第四人在Bloor街被捕
title.en: Fourth arrest as Bloor bike lane removal protests continue

summary.zh: 省府10月13日开始拆除Bloor街西段自行车道，抗议者多次阻拦，目前已有四人因妨碍警察和恶作剧罪被捕。省府计划拆除Bloor、Yonge和University约19公里的保护式车道，交通部长称车道一定会拆。Cycle Toronto表示将申请上诉到最高法院。
summary.en: Four people have now been arrested at protests against the province's removal of the Bloor Street West bike lanes, which began Oct. 13. They face mischief and obstruction charges. The province plans to remove about 19 kilometres of protected lanes on Bloor, Yonge and University, and the transportation minister says they are coming out. Cycle Toronto will seek leave to appeal to the Supreme Court.

title.zh: 列治文山半独立屋大火致69岁男子死亡
title.en: Richmond Hill fire kills man, 69, as two homes burn

summary.zh: 列治文山Crosby Avenue周三凌晨约3点起火，火势波及两栋半独立屋。69岁男子在一户地下室被救出，已无生命迹象，早上约6点被宣布死亡；另一人从地下室窗户获救，情况稳定。警方称火源是一辆停在车道上的汽车，起火原因仍在调查。
summary.en: A 69-year-old man died after a fire spread from a vehicle in a driveway to two semi-detached homes on Crosby Avenue in Richmond Hill early Wednesday. Another person was pulled from a basement window and is stable. The fire chief called the scene chaotic, with vehicle fires blocking entrances. The Office of the Fire Marshal is helping investigate.

title.zh: King镇三车相撞致一死，特斯拉起火
title.en: One dead in three-vehicle crash in King Township

summary.zh: 周四凌晨，Jane街与Davis Drive West交叉口发生三车相撞，一辆特斯拉起火，司机当场死亡。另有一人送医，两人接受检查。约克区警方封闭Davis Drive部分路段调查，目前无人被控，事故原因尚未确定。
summary.en: One person died in a three-vehicle crash early Thursday at Jane Street and Davis Drive West in King Township, York police say. The Tesla's driver was pronounced dead at the scene after the car caught fire. One other person went to hospital and two were assessed. Davis Drive was closed for the investigation, and no charges have been laid.

title.zh: 17岁少年疑酒后爆胎开车险撞行人被控
title.en: Teen, 17, charged after allegedly driving impaired on rims

summary.zh: 多伦多警方说，一名17岁少年在东区疑似酒后驾驶，车轮已爆胎仍在行驶，差点撞到行人。逮捕过程被视频拍下，少年面临控罪。警方未在此阶段公布更多细节。
summary.en: Toronto police say a 17-year-old boy faces charges after allegedly driving impaired in the city's east end and nearly hitting a pedestrian while driving on rims. The arrest was captured on video. Police have not released more detail on the charges, and none of the allegations have been tested in court.

title.zh: 9月多伦多近3000只鸟撞楼，数量比去年翻倍
title.en: Nearly 3,000 birds hit Toronto buildings in September, double last year

summary.zh: FLAP Canada的数据显示，9月多伦多地区有约2,923只鸟撞上建筑物，比去年同月多出一倍以上。市政府和FLAP估计，多伦多每年约有一百万只鸟因撞楼死亡，迁徙季尤其严重。
summary.en: FLAP Canada counted about 2,923 birds hitting buildings in the Toronto area in September, more than double the same month last year. The city and FLAP estimate about one million birds die in building collisions in Toronto each year, especially during spring and fall migration.

title.zh: 士嘉堡拖车场老板被控涉嫌谋杀密谋罪
title.en: Scarborough tow lot owner charged in alleged murder plot

summary.zh: 《多伦多星报》报道，一名士嘉堡拖车场老板因涉嫌谋杀密谋被起诉。有报道称他面临两项合谋谋杀罪名，涉及沃恩一家汽车修理店的经营者。这起案件与大多伦多地区近年的拖车业争斗有关，指控尚未在法庭上证实。
summary.en: The Toronto Star reports a Scarborough tow lot owner has been charged in an alleged murder plot. Other coverage says the 43-year-old faces two counts of conspiracy to commit murder, with an auto body shop operator in Vaughan among the alleged targets. The case is tied to the GTA's tow truck turf disputes. The charges have not been proven in court.

title.zh: 哈尔顿地区上半年入室盗窃减少22%
title.en: Halton break-ins down 22 per cent in first half of 2026

summary.zh: 哈尔顿警方的年中报告显示，2026年上半年入室盗窃同比下降22%，少了87起；暴力犯罪下降18.4%。1月至6月全部案件共6,623起，比去年同期减少900起，约降12%。报告涵盖奥克维尔、伯灵顿、米尔顿和哈尔顿山。
summary.en: Halton Regional Police's mid-year report shows break-and-enters fell 22 per cent in the first half of 2026, 87 fewer than a year earlier, while violent crime dropped 18.4 per cent. Total offences from January to June were 6,623, down about 12 per cent. The report covers Oakville, Burlington, Milton and Halton Hills.

title.zh: 皮尔警方「Project High Guard」：10人被捕、128项指控
title.en: Peel police: 10 arrested, 128 charges in carjacking and vehicle-theft probe

summary.zh: 皮尔区警方公布「Project High Guard」调查结果：10人被捕，共被控128项罪名，案件涉及劫车和盗车。9月3日行动中，警方追回15辆被盗车辆，总值约140万加元，并查获四支非法枪械。涉案嫌疑人被指控的罪名尚未在法庭上证实。
summary.en: Peel Regional Police say Project High Guard, a carjacking and vehicle-theft investigation, led to 10 arrests and 128 charges. In raids on Sept. 3, officers recovered 15 stolen vehicles worth about $1.4 million and seized four illegal firearms. Police said the investigation involved violent carjackings, and the charges have not been proven in court.

title.zh: 安省免费流感疫苗下周一起向公众开放
title.en: Ontario's free flu shot opens to everyone on Monday

summary.zh: 从10月26日起，凡在安省居住、工作或上学、年满6个月的人，都可免费接种流感疫苗。可在药房、公共卫生部门和医生诊所接种，药房接种对象为2岁及以上。建议先打电话确认疫苗库存。
summary.en: Starting Monday, Oct. 26, anyone six months or older who lives, works or studies in Ontario can get a free flu shot at pharmacies, public health units and doctors' or nurse practitioners' offices. Pharmacists can vaccinate people aged two and up. CHCH advises calling ahead to confirm supply.

title.zh: 加拿大
title.en: Canada

title.zh: 卡尼访问土耳其，两国启动贸易与国防战略伙伴关系
title.en: Carney and Erdogan launch Canada-Turkey strategic partnership

summary.zh: 卡尼周四在安卡拉与埃尔多安宣布战略伙伴关系，涵盖贸易投资、国防安全、能源和民间交流四大支柱，另有三年行动计划。下月将在安卡拉启动首轮自贸谈判，两国还拟成立工作组研究加拿大坎杜核电的投标可能。卡尼称与价值观不同的国家做生意不等于认同。
summary.en: Prime Minister Mark Carney and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan launched a strategic partnership in Ankara covering trade, defence, energy and people-to-people ties, with a three-year action plan. First free trade talks start in Ankara next month, and a working group may study a Candu nuclear bid. Carney said doing business with countries is not the same as approving their values.

title.zh: 乔利否认干预美国中期选举，外交官被告知避免与候选人同台
title.en: Joly denies meddling in U.S. midterms; diplomats told to avoid candidates

summary.zh: 美国使馆列出九点「事实」，指乔利和福特等加拿大官员试图影响美国政治。乔利说「绝对没有」，称会见共和党和民主党人只是外交。渥太华同时告诉驻美外交官，中期选举期间避免与候选人会面或同台，全球事务部称这是惯例。卡尼在土耳其说指控「毫无根据」。
summary.en: The U.S. Embassy listed nine "facts" it says show Canadian officials, mostly Industry Minister Mélanie Joly and Premier Doug Ford, trying to influence American politics. Joly said "absolutely not," calling her meetings with both parties normal diplomacy. Ottawa has told diplomats in the U.S. not to meet or appear with midterm candidates, which Global Affairs calls standard practice. Carney also said the claims have no merit.

title.zh: 史密斯：UCP必须亲加拿大，亲独立人士可「加入别的政党」
title.en: Smith tells UCP separatists to back Canada or join another party

summary.zh: 阿尔伯塔省长史密斯说，联合保守党不是独立党，不愿接受公投结果的少数人可以加入别的政党。约四分之三选民在周一公投中选择留在加拿大。她说，若党内继续公开主张分离，这些人在2027年选举前将不能当候选人或地方党务委员。
summary.en: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith says the United Conservative Party is not an independence party, and the few members who cannot accept Monday's result can join a different party. Roughly 75 per cent of Albertans voted to stay in Canada. She said members who keep publicly pushing separation won't be welcome as candidates or on local boards before the 2027 election.

title.zh: 阿尔伯塔选举局错过计票期限，欺诈传言被驳斥
title.en: Elections Alberta misses count deadline; fraud claims rejected

summary.zh: 阿尔伯塔选举局因人手不足、轮班太长，没能在48小时内数完周一公投的选票，正式结果预定10月29日公布。网上流传的「大量邮寄票被倒入」和「投票数多于登记选民」说法，被该机构和专家驳斥。每名选民有10张选票，所以总票数会高于选民人数。
summary.en: Elections Alberta missed its 48-hour deadline to finish counting Monday's referendum ballots, blaming long shifts and low staffing, with official results due Oct. 29. The agency and a political scientist rejected online claims of fraud. Each voter received 10 ballots, one per question, so total votes naturally exceed the number of voters, and Question 10 was counted first.

title.zh: 56位科学家呼吁修改C-39号大项目法案，保护濒危物种
title.en: Scientists urge changes to Bill C-39 to protect species at risk

summary.zh: 56名加拿大皇家学会院士联名公开信，要求国会修改《建设加拿大强大法案》（C-39）。他们支持加快审批，但担心条款削弱对濒危物种及其栖息地的保护，并列出六项修改建议，包括为联邦特别权力设定期限。该学会表示信件不代表学会官方立场。
summary.en: Fifty-six Royal Society of Canada fellows have signed an open letter asking Parliament to amend Bill C-39, the Building Canada Strong Act. They back faster approvals but warn the bill could weaken protections for species at risk and their habitats, and they propose six amendments, including a time limit on special federal powers. The society says the letter is not its official position.

title.zh: 乔利给Stelco母公司15天期限撤回裁员，否则诉诸法院
title.en: Ottawa gives Stelco owner 15 days to reverse layoffs or face court

summary.zh: 工业部长乔利周四致函Stelco美国母公司克利夫兰-克里夫斯，称其在汉密尔顿和纳蒂科克的最多500人临时裁员违反《加拿大投资法》下的就业承诺，限15天内撤销。若不照办，政府将诉诸法院，可能面临罚款甚至被迫出售加拿大业务。公司称裁员是为「生存」，因美国关税冲击销量。
summary.en: Industry Minister Mélanie Joly sent Stelco's U.S. owner, Cleveland-Cliffs, a letter giving it 15 days to reverse layoffs of up to 500 workers in Hamilton and Nanticoke, saying they breach job commitments under the Investment Canada Act. Otherwise Ottawa will go to court, with possible penalties or a forced sale. The company says the cuts are needed for survival because of U.S. tariffs.

title.zh: 全国食物银行月访问量创纪录，达约236万人次
title.en: Food bank visits hit a record 2.36 million a month

summary.zh: 加拿大食物银行协会的HungerCount报告显示，2026年3月全国食物银行访问量约235.5万人次，比去年3月增长8.7%，创纪录；其中儿童约77.6万人次。报告说，自2021年以来食品价格涨约30%，住房涨28%，交通涨约24%，五分之一的食物银行在满足所有客户前就已缺粮。
summary.en: Food Banks Canada's HungerCount report says food banks recorded about 2.36 million visits in March 2026, up 8.7 per cent from the previous record a year earlier, with children making nearly 776,000 of them. Food prices are up about 30 per cent since 2021, housing 28 per cent and transportation 24 per cent. One in five food banks is running out of food before meeting needs.

title.zh: 大草原北部本周末迎来强秋季风暴，萨省北部或降雪50厘米
title.en: Fall storm to bring up to 50 cm of snow to northern Saskatchewan

summary.zh: 加拿大环境部发布特别天气声明：强秋季风暴周五开始、持续到周六，萨斯喀彻温省北部先下雨再转为湿重大雪，部分地区积雪可达25至50厘米。曼尼托巴北部预计15至25厘米，并有冻雨和吹雪，能见度大降。周日起天气转好。
summary.en: Environment Canada has issued special weather statements for a significant fall storm starting Friday. Rain will turn to heavy, wet snow in northern Saskatchewan, with 25 to 50 centimetres possible in the hardest-hit areas. Northern Manitoba could see 15 to 25 centimetres with freezing rain and blowing snow cutting visibility. Conditions should improve on Sunday as the snow tapers off.

title.zh: 加航取消2027年五条美国航线，包括多伦多—查尔斯顿
title.en: Air Canada drops five U.S. routes for 2027, including Toronto-Charleston

summary.zh: 加拿大航空从2027年夏季时刻表中删去五条美国航线：多伦多皮尔逊—查尔斯顿、比利比晓普—波士顿、温哥华—纳什维尔、温哥华—罗利达勒姆，以及蒙特利尔—西雅图。公司称出于商业原因。报道把需求下滑归因于政治紧张、关税、加元偏弱和燃油成本，西捷今年也已削减10条美国航线。
summary.en: Air Canada has removed five U.S. routes from its summer 2027 schedule: Toronto Pearson-Charleston, Billy Bishop-Boston, Vancouver-Nashville, Vancouver-Raleigh-Durham and Montreal-Seattle, citing commercial reasons. Coverage links weaker demand to political tensions, tariffs, a weaker dollar and fuel costs. WestJet has already cut 10 U.S. routes this year.

title.zh: CTV：渥太华尚未关上中期选举前达成「闪电」贸易协议的大门
title.en: Ottawa hasn't ruled out a snap U.S. trade deal before midterms: CTV

summary.zh: CTV独家报道，知情人士称加拿大官员未排除在11月3日美国中期选举前与美国达成速成贸易协议，但希望渺茫。贸易部长勒布朗据报道对咨询委员会说「什么都可能发生」。另据CBC，消息人士说选前达成协议的窗口基本已关闭，勒布朗也称不预期选前有协议。
summary.en: CTV reports that Canadian officials have not ruled out a snap trade deal with the U.S. before the Nov. 3 midterms, though sources say hope is faint. Trade Minister Dominic LeBlanc reportedly told an advisory committee anything could happen. CBC sources said earlier that the window had effectively closed, and LeBlanc said he does not expect a deal before the vote.

title.zh: 圣热罗姆一所高中因骚乱和破坏停学78名学生
title.en: Quebec high school suspends 78 students after unrest and vandalism

summary.zh: 魁北克圣热罗姆综合中学10月16日出现混乱，学生扔垃圾桶、聚集成群，有人拉响火警，警方到场。学校委员会已停学78名学生，校方周一停课审查录像，并将增加保安和警力。据称事件与学生号召行动有关，处分仍可能增加。
summary.en: A high school in Saint-Jérôme, Que., has suspended 78 students after disorder on Oct. 16, when students threw garbage cans, formed crowds and pulled a fire alarm, and police were called. The school closed Monday to review video and is adding security guards and more police presence. The board says more discipline is possible.

title.zh: 研究：加拿大潜鸟数量长期显著下降
title.en: Study finds substantial long-term declines in Canada's loons

summary.zh: 发表在《FACETS》期刊的研究由加拿大鸟类组织的富尔斯特主导，发现12个繁殖区中除一个外，潜鸟都出现长期显著下降，大西洋省份和大草原省份降幅最大。加拿大仍拥有该物种约94%的数量，所以它目前并非濒危。潜鸟还印在一加元硬币上。
summary.en: A study in the journal FACETS led by Matthew Fuirst of Birds Canada finds substantial long-term declines in common loons in all but one of 12 breeding regions, with the steepest losses in Atlantic Canada and the Prairies. Canada holds about 94 per cent of the species' population, so loons are not currently endangered.

title.zh: 卑诗亿万富翁胡氏旗下公司指加拿大税务局「不当行为成风」
title.en: B.C. developer's firms accuse CRA of 'pattern of misconduct' in tax fight

summary.zh: 卑诗地产商Terry Hui控制的公司向联邦法院提出申诉，指加拿大税务局官员在追缴税款时违反既定政策。政府追缴约3.3亿加元，大部分是利息，争议始于2013年开始的审计，涉及卢森堡税务条约。税务局称暂无发言人就税收条约滥用置评。
summary.en: Companies controlled by B.C. developer Terry Hui have filed in Federal Court alleging a pattern of misconduct by the Canada Revenue Agency, saying its officers acted outside established policies while trying to collect about $330 million, mostly interest. The dispute stems from an audit begun in 2013 on transactions relying on Canada's tax treaty with Luxembourg. The CRA had no spokesperson available to comment.

title.zh: 温哥华市中心一只臭鼬咬伤数人，检测呈狂犬病阳性
title.en: Rabid skunk bites several people in downtown Vancouver

summary.zh: 卑诗官员说，温哥华市中心一只臭鼬咬伤了少数几个人，经检测狂犬病呈阳性。CBC报道称被咬人数不多，官员的通报发布于周三。卫生部门正在跟进，情况仍在更新中。
summary.en: B.C. officials say a skunk that bit a small number of people in downtown Vancouver has tested positive for rabies. CBC reported the bites on Wednesday, and health officials are following up. The story is still developing, and further details have not yet been released.

title.zh: 美国
title.en: United States

title.zh: 华尔街周四收跌：纳斯达克重挫2.6%，标普500创7月以来最差一天
title.en: Wall Street slides Thursday: Nasdaq off 2.6%, S&P 500 worst day since July

summary.zh: 周四美股科技股领跌：标普500下跌93.74点或1.2%，收7,663.43；纳斯达克下跌694点或2.6%，收26,008.86；道指小涨11.89点，收52,867.98。多伦多S&P/TSX综合指数跌约1%，收35,973.45，矿业和科技股拖累。国债收益率下滑，因市场重新担心AI投入能否持续。
summary.en: U.S. stocks fell Thursday on a tech selloff. The S&P 500 lost 93.74 points, or 1.2 per cent, to 7,663.43, its worst day since July, and the Nasdaq dropped 694 points, or 2.6 per cent, to 26,008.86. The Dow edged up 11.89 points to 52,867.98. Toronto's S&P/TSX fell nearly 1 per cent to 35,973.45, weighed down by miners and tech.

title.zh: Meta披露8250亿美元AI承诺，股价重挫7%
title.en: Meta falls 7% after disclosing $825 billion in AI commitments

summary.zh: Meta在第三季度财报中披露约8250亿美元与AI相关的未来承诺，高于7月的约7000亿，股价收跌约7%，报648.85美元。公司当季自由现金流转为亏损21亿美元，并把2026年资本开支预期上调至1350亿至1450亿美元。该消息拖累芯片股，英伟达跌4.4%，AMD跌8.1%。
summary.en: Meta disclosed about $825 billion in future AI-related commitments, up from roughly $700 billion in July, and its shares closed down about 7 per cent at $648.85. Third-quarter free cash flow swung to a $2.1 billion deficit, and 2026 capital spending guidance rose to $135 billion to $145 billion. Chip stocks also fell, with Nvidia down 4.4 per cent and AMD down 8.1 per cent.

title.zh: 《纽约时报》：美以拟定中期选举后对伊朗新一轮打击计划
title.en: NYT: U.S., Israel draft plans to strike Iran after midterms

summary.zh: 《纽约时报》引述美国官员报道，美国和以色列已制定在11月3日中期选举后再次打击伊朗的具体计划，称将是「短暂但强烈」的行动，可能涉及能源设施、核设施和导弹无人机库存。特朗普说伊朗问题「很快会有结果」。美国同时要求驻沙特的非紧急人员撤离。
summary.en: The New York Times, citing U.S. officials, reports that the U.S. and Israel have drafted specific plans for renewed strikes on Iran after the Nov. 3 midterms, a "short but intensive" operation that could hit energy, nuclear and missile targets. Trump said something will happen "fairly soon." Washington has also ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia.

title.zh: 布伦特原油涨4%至113.17美元，创5月以来新高
title.en: Brent crude jumps 4% to $113.17, highest since May

summary.zh: 伊朗局势升温，周四国际基准布伦特原油期货上涨约4%，收于每桶113.17美元，为5月4日以来最高。美国汽油全国均价每加仑4.27美元。油价上涨对加拿大司机同样是坏消息，因为加拿大9月通胀已因汽油上涨推高至3.1%。
summary.en: Brent crude futures rose about 4 per cent to close at $113.17 a barrel Thursday, the highest since May 4, after Trump hinted at action on Iran. The U.S. average gasoline price is $4.27 a gallon. Higher oil is bad news for Canadian drivers too, since gasoline already pushed Canada's September inflation up to 3.1 per cent.

title.zh: 特朗普力挺拉马斯瓦米攻击广告，共和党人批评
title.en: Trump defends Ramaswamy's attack ad as Republicans object

summary.zh: 俄亥俄州州长竞选中，拉马斯瓦米的广告请出民主党对手阿克顿的生母，称她是骗子。特朗普称广告「有力」，说媒体在施压要拉马斯瓦米撤下。州长德怀恩说广告「深深令人不安」，应撤下；万斯则为广告辩护。库克政治报告把该州州长选战评为势均力敌。
summary.en: Vivek Ramaswamy's Ohio governor ad features the estranged mother of Democratic nominee Amy Acton calling her a liar. Trump called the ad powerful and defended it, while Gov. Mike DeWine called it deeply troubling and said it should come down. JD Vance defended the ad. The Cook Political Report rates the race a toss-up.

title.zh: 法官叫停国土安全部在九州的选民欺诈调查
title.en: Judge halts DHS voter-fraud probes in nine states

summary.zh: 联邦法官马丁内斯-奥尔金周三裁定，国土安全部须暂停针对已知或疑似美国公民的部分非法投票调查，适用九个州，理由是可能构成恐吓选民。命令有效期到选举日投票结束，但法官已把命令暂缓到周五下午5点，让政府有时间上诉。国土安全部称将继续追查外国人投票。
summary.en: A federal judge in California ruled Wednesday that the Department of Homeland Security must halt certain illegal-voting investigations in nine states that target known or suspected U.S. citizens, citing the risk of voter intimidation. The order lasts until polls close on Election Day, but is on hold until 5 p.m. Friday so the administration can appeal. DHS says it is focused on aliens who vote.

title.zh: 最高法院维持禁令，暂不允许联邦监狱终止跨性别囚犯激素治疗
title.en: Supreme Court leaves block on prison hormone-therapy cutoff

summary.zh: 美国最高法院周三拒绝让联邦监狱局在诉讼期间执行新政策，该政策原本会停止新开激素处方，并让已用药者逐步减药。大法官阿利托和托马斯表示本会批准政府申请。这只是程序性裁决，政策最终是否合法仍待审理，监狱局目前仍为约600人提供激素治疗。
summary.en: The Supreme Court on Wednesday declined to let the Bureau of Prisons enforce its new policy on transgender inmates while litigation continues, leaving a lower-court order in place. The policy would have barred new hormone prescriptions and tapered existing ones. Justices Alito and Thomas would have granted the request. The ruling is procedural, and about 600 inmates still receive hormone therapy.

title.zh: 特朗普赴南卡罗来纳为共和党参议员候选人造势，席位面临风险
title.en: Trump rallies in South Carolina as a Senate seat tightens

summary.zh: 特朗普周三在南卡罗来纳州彭德尔顿集会，为当地共和党参议员候选人拉票，库克政治报告前一天把该席位从「共和党稳」调为「偏共和党」。民主党对手安妮·安德鲁斯说这是胶着的竞争。该选战已吸引超过3,400万美元资金，胜者将成为南卡首位当选联邦参议员的女性。
summary.en: Trump rallied in Pendleton, South Carolina, on Wednesday for the Republican Senate nominee, a day after the Cook Political Report moved the race from likely Republican to lean Republican. Democrat Annie Andrews called it neck and neck. More than $34 million has flowed into the race, and the winner will be the first woman elected to the U.S. Senate from the state.

title.zh: 福克斯新闻排名：农村选民因生活成本与油价转向，共和党失势
title.en: Fox News rankings: rural voters drift from GOP over costs and gas prices

summary.zh: 福克斯新闻的权力排名文章称，农村选民对共和党的支持在中期选举前下降，原因是生活成本、油价和失业担忧。这类选民是特朗普基本盘的一部分。距11月3日投票只剩约十天。
summary.en: A Fox News Power Rankings piece says rural voter support for Republicans is dropping ahead of the Nov. 3 midterms, driven by concerns about the cost of living, gas prices and unemployment. Rural voters are a core part of Trump's base, and election day is about 11 days away.

title.zh: 杰弗里斯：民主党「即将」夺回众议院，担心共和党使出「阴险手段」
title.en: Jeffries says Democrats are 'on the verge' of retaking the House

summary.zh: 据CNN，众议院少数党领袖杰弗里斯说民主党「即将」夺回众议院，但担心共和党会想出「阴险的计划」，阻碍11月3日自由公平的选举。CNN的民调综合显示，缅因州的柯林斯与民主党特洛伊·杰克逊之间没有明显领先者。
summary.en: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries told CNN his party is on the verge of regaining control of the House, but he fears Republicans could come up with a "diabolical scheme" to block a free and fair election on Nov. 3. CNN's poll of polls shows no clear leader in Maine's Senate race between Susan Collins and Democrat Troy Jackson.

title.zh: 特朗普放弃对俄罗斯的《格雷厄姆法》制裁与关税，两党批评
title.en: Trump waives Russia sanctions and tariffs, drawing bipartisan criticism

summary.zh: 特朗普10月16日签署行政令，豁免《格雷厄姆法》下对俄罗斯的大部分制裁和关税，其中包括对俄油气最大买家的最高100%关税。行政令称这符合国家利益，报道将此与压低燃油价格的努力联系起来。参议员蒂利斯称此举「完全不负责任」，泽连斯基说这「似乎是错的」。
summary.en: Trump signed an order on Oct. 16 waiving most Graham Act sanctions and tariffs on Russia, including tariffs of up to 100 per cent on top buyers of Russian oil and gas. The order says the waiver is in the national interest, and reporting ties it to efforts to lower fuel prices. Sen. Thom Tillis called it entirely irresponsible, and Ukraine's Zelenskyy said it seemed wrong.

title.zh: 胡塞武装袭击沙特机场与油田，美国令驻沙使馆非紧急人员撤离
title.en: Houthi strikes hit Saudi airport and oil field; U.S. pulls non-emergency staff

summary.zh: 据报道，也门胡塞武装周三袭击达曼国王法赫德国际机场，造成至少1死8伤，另有无人机袭击阿美公司的谢拜油田，造成2人死亡。美国国务院下令驻沙特机构的非紧急人员及家属离开。革命卫队同日称有油轮被点燃或触雷，特朗普指伊朗编造攻击船只的说法以推高油价，各说法尚未获独立证实。
summary.en: Yemen's Houthis struck King Fahd International Airport in Dammam on Wednesday, killing at least one person and wounding eight, and a drone attack on Aramco's Shaybah field killed two, according to reports. The U.S. State Department ordered non-emergency staff and families out of its missions in Saudi Arabia. Iran's Guard claimed tankers were hit, while Trump says Iran made up ship strikes to lift oil prices.

title.zh: 体育
title.en: Sports

title.zh: 枫叶最后26秒绝杀，5比4险胜游骑兵取三连胜
title.en: Leafs edge Rangers 5-4 on Stecher's late goal for third straight win

summary.zh: 枫叶在主场以5比4击败游骑兵，斯特切尔在常规时间剩26.3秒时射入决胜球，里利送出助攻。杜海姆一球两助，布鲁格、马尔琴科和考恩也各进一球，博布罗夫斯基扑出21球。枫叶取得三连胜，战绩6胜4负2加时负，接着开始四场客场之旅。
summary.en: The Maple Leafs beat the Rangers 5-4 at Scotiabank Arena on Thursday, with Troy Stecher scoring with 26.3 seconds left in regulation off a Morgan Rielly pass. Brandon Duhaime had a goal and two assists, Teddy Blueger, Kirill Marchenko and Easton Cowan also scored, and Sergei Bobrovsky made 21 saves. Toronto, 6-4-2, won its third straight and now starts a four-game road trip.

title.zh: 麦克戴维两球三助，油人点球大战6比5力克飓风
title.en: McDavid's five points lead Oilers past Hurricanes 6-5 in shootout

summary.zh: 油人在主场通过点球大战以6比5击败飓风，麦克戴维和德莱赛特尔各打进两球并送出三次助攻。油人第三节一度2比4落后，随后连追两球，麦克戴维在剩1分28秒时扳平，最终由努金-霍普金斯点球得手。油人8胜1负1加时负。
summary.en: Connor McDavid and Leon Draisaitl each had two goals and three assists as the Oilers beat the Hurricanes 6-5 in a shootout at Rogers Place. Edmonton trailed 4-2 in the third period before rallying, and McDavid tied it with 1:28 left in regulation. Ryan Nugent-Hopkins scored the only shootout goal, and the Oilers improved to 8-1-1.

title.zh: 库利扑出36球，火焰2比1险胜野人
title.en: Cooley makes 36 saves as Flames edge Wild 2-1

summary.zh: 火焰在主场以2比1击败野人，苏涅夫和法拉比在首节各打进一个多打一进球。第三节野人以17比3压制射门，但库利扑出36球，守住胜利。火焰战绩3胜6负，队长巴克兰因上肢伤势缺阵，被列为每日观察。
summary.en: The Flames beat the Wild 2-1 at the Saddledome, with both goals coming on first-period power plays from Aydar Suniev and Farabee. Minnesota outshot Calgary 17-3 in the third period, but Devin Cooley made 36 saves overall to hold on. The Flames improved to 3-6-0, and captain Mikael Backlund missed the game with an upper-body injury.

title.zh: 鲨鱼6比2大胜渥太华参议员，乌尔曼因伤进伤病名单
title.en: Sharks beat Senators 6-2; Ullmark placed on injured reserve

summary.zh: 鲨鱼在渥太华以6比2击败参议员，取得本季首场常规时间胜利，阿斯卡罗夫扑出多达39球，另有报道称41球。参议员的施图茨勒和斯宾塞各进一球。门将乌尔曼前一晚下半身受伤，已进入伤病名单。
summary.en: The Sharks beat the Senators 6-2 in Ottawa for their first regulation win of the season, with Yaroslav Askarov stopping 39 shots by ESPN's count. Tim Stutzle and Jordan Spence scored for Ottawa, and Samuel Ersson made 23 saves. Ottawa placed goalie Linus Ullmark on injured reserve with a lower-body injury suffered a night earlier.

title.zh: 熊队30比24力克爱国者，威廉姆斯传球308码
title.en: Bears hold off Patriots 30-24; Williams throws for 308 yards

summary.zh: 周四晚橄榄球赛，芝加哥熊队在主场以30比24击败新英格兰爱国者，战绩升至5胜2负。威廉姆斯在伤愈复出后第二场比赛中传球308码、两次达阵；桑托斯在剩1分34秒时踢进职业生涯最长的58码射门。爱国者的梅伊传球321码、两次达阵。
summary.en: The Chicago Bears beat the New England Patriots 30-24 on Thursday night to improve to 5-2. Caleb Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns in his second game back from a hamstring injury, and Cairo Santos kicked a career-long 58-yard field goal with 1:34 left. Drake Maye threw for 321 yards and two touchdowns for New England.

title.zh: NBA揭幕战：雷霆116比104击败马刺，文班亚马前12投不中
title.en: NBA opener: Thunder beat Spurs 116-104; Wembanyama misses first 12 shots

summary.zh: NBA新赛季揭幕战，雷霆在圣安东尼奥以116比104击败马刺。亚历山大得32分，麦凯恩替补得20分并命中六记三分。文班亚马前12投不中，全场13投仅1中，得12分、13个篮板和6次盖帽。马刺曾落后26分，下半场开局以23比9反击。
summary.en: In the NBA season opener, the Thunder beat the Spurs 116-104 in San Antonio. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 32, and Jared McCain added 20 off the bench with six three-pointers. Victor Wembanyama missed his first 12 shots and finished 1 of 13 with 12 points, 13 rebounds and six blocks. San Antonio trailed by 26 in the first half but ran off a 23-9 burst after the break.

title.zh: 爱德华兹砍下45分，森林狼131比106大胜热火
title.en: Edwards scores 45 as Timberwolves rout Heat 131-106 in opener

summary.zh: 森林狼在新赛季首战以131比106击败热火，爱德华兹砍下45分，投中九记三分，创下球队开幕战个人得分纪录。他与张伯伦成为NBA历史上仅有的连续两个赛季揭幕战都至少得40分的球员。拉梅洛·鲍尔得21分、6次助攻。
summary.en: Anthony Edwards scored 45 points, hitting nine three-pointers, as the Timberwolves beat the Heat 131-106 in their season opener. It is the most points by a Timberwolves player in a season opener, and Edwards joined Wilt Chamberlain as the only players with 40 or more points in consecutive openers. LaMelo Ball added 21 points and six assists.

title.zh: 奥格-阿利亚西姆因膝伤退出布鲁塞尔和巴塞尔，无缘ATP总决赛
title.en: Auger-Aliassime out of Brussels and Basel with knee injury, ATP Finals hopes end

summary.zh: 加拿大球员奥格-阿利亚西姆因上海站膝伤，退出布鲁塞尔和巴塞尔赛事。由于要放弃布鲁塞尔夺冠的250分，他在年终积分榜上跌至第15位，基本无缘ATP总决赛，也将跌出世界前十。他能否出战11月2日开打的巴黎大师赛仍不确定。
summary.en: Canada's Félix Auger-Aliassime has withdrawn from Brussels and Basel because of a knee injury from Shanghai. By giving up the 250 points from his Brussels title, he slips to 15th in the Race and has effectively lost his ATP Finals bid, and he will fall out of the top 10. His status for the Paris Masters, which starts Nov. 2, is uncertain.
